spec.purpose: Reclassify every CI-W1C.7.3 G01 anchor (A01..A15) plus supplementary project-record anchors (S01..S13) into exactly one of 8 authority categories. PLANNING_STRATEGIC_SOURCE / USER_REQUIREMENT / PROJECT_METADATA count as positive planning retention; LEGACY_VISUAL_EVIDENCE / VISUAL_DIAGNOSIS / CREATIVE_HYPOTHESIS are legacy positive (must be 0 in Need/Prompt/Synthesis). LOCKED_IDENTITY is tracked separately as constraint retention.

summary.keyFinding: ZERO PLANNING_STRATEGIC_SOURCE anchors. The 15 anchors CI-W1C.7.3 measured were ALL legacy positive (visual or visual diagnosis). The only legitimate planning-positive content is 3 USER_REQUIREMENT constraints + 1 PROJECT_METADATA placeholder. The legitimate planning retention curve will be near-zero from Stage 1 onwards.
